name: diff-viewer
title: Diff Viewer / Merge Editor
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Line and word-level diffing built on a real Myers algorithm implementation, plus three-way merge with per-conflict accept-ours/accept-theirs resolution. Split or unified view, foldable context.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/diff-viewer. Pass two strings to DiffViewerRoot for a line/word-level diff, or three (base, ours, theirs) for a merge editor with per-conflict resolution. DiffViewerLayout renders split or unified view with foldable unchanged context.
